text: (1) IN CRISIS: DIAL 988 THEN PRESS 1, or text 838255. Available to ALL veterans regardless of enrollment, discharge characterization, or deployment history. Under the COMPACT Act, eligible veterans in acute suicidal crisis may receive emergency care at ANY facility at NO COST.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (2) GET FREE ACCREDITED REPRESENTATION BEFORE FILING ANYTHING. VSOs -- DAV, VFW, American Legion, AMVETS, PVA -- and COUNTY VETERAN SERVICE OFFICERS are free for the life of the claim. Verify accreditation at va.gov/ogc/apps/accreditation.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (3) NOBODY MAY CHARGE A FEE FOR PREPARING AN INITIAL CLAIM. Consultants charging thousands are doing work that is free.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (4) FILE AN INTENT TO FILE THE DAY YOU DECIDE TO CLAIM. It locks the effective date for a year and can be worth a year of back pay.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (5) THE NEXUS IS WHERE CLAIMS FAIL. Get a treating physician to write that the condition is AT LEAST AS LIKELY AS NOT related to service.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (6) CLAIM SECONDARY CONDITIONS -- sleep apnea secondary to PTSD, depression secondary to chronic pain, neuropathy secondary to diabetes. Commonly granted, rarely claimed.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (7) AT THE C&P EXAM, DESCRIBE YOUR WORST AND AVERAGE DAYS, NOT YOUR BEST. Say when pain BEGINS during movement. REQUEST THE EXAM REPORT afterward.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (8) ASK ABOUT TDIU -- it pays at the 100 percent rate without a 100 percent rating -- and about EXTRASCHEDULAR TDIU if you are below the thresholds.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (9) ASK ABOUT SMC, especially SMC(K) for loss of use including erectile dysfunction secondary to a service-connected condition or medication. Additional monthly money, missed constantly.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (10) A PRIOR DENIAL DOES NOT BAR A NEW CLAIM under a PACT Act presumption that did not exist then. File a supplemental claim.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (11) GULF WAR UNDIAGNOSED ILLNESS NEEDS NO DIAGNOSIS. Lay evidence of chronic symptoms can establish it.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (12) APPEAL WITHIN 1 YEAR to preserve the effective date. Higher-level review for VA error with NO new evidence -- and REQUEST THE INFORMAL CONFERENCE. Supplemental claim when you have NEW evidence. Board appeal for a judge.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (13) COURT APPEAL IS 120 DAYS FROM THE BOARD DECISION AND IS JURISDICTIONAL. Free representation through the Veterans Consortium Pro Bono Program at 888-838-7727 and NVLSP.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (14) CLEAR AND UNMISTAKABLE ERROR HAS NO TIME LIMIT. A decision from decades ago can be revised for an undebatable legal error, with the effective date going back to the original claim.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (15) YOU DO NOT NEED A DISCHARGE UPGRADE TO GET VA BENEFITS. VA makes its own CHARACTER OF DISCHARGE determination, independent of the branch. File and request it.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (16) APPLY FOR A DISCHARGE UPGRADE EVEN DECADES LATER. The correction board deadline is routinely waived, and liberal consideration policies for PTSD, TBI, and MST have changed outcomes dramatically.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (17) VET CENTERS REQUIRE NO VA ENROLLMENT and keep records SEPARATE from VA medical records. 877-927-8387.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (18) MST CARE IS FREE, requires no rating and no contemporaneous report, and claims use MARKERS as evidence -- transfer requests, performance changes, behavior changes.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (19) NON-VA EMERGENCY CARE: NOTIFY VA WITHIN 72 HOURS or the bill may become yours.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (20) NON-EMERGENCY COMMUNITY CARE REQUIRES AUTHORIZATION FIRST. Ask in writing whether you meet a drive-time or wait-time access standard.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (21) APPLY FOR VA HEALTH CARE EVEN IF YOU THINK YOU ARE INELIGIBLE. Eligibility is broader than nearly every veteran believes.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (22) HOMELESS OR AT RISK: 877-424-3838, 24 hours. Call BEFORE an eviction judgment -- SSVF prevention money is far easier to deploy early.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (23) VA LOAN TECHNICIANS AT 877-827-3702 HELP WITH FORECLOSURE EVEN ON NON-VA MORTGAGES. Call at the first missed payment.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (24) THE FUNDING FEE IS WAIVED for veterans receiving compensation, and may be REFUNDABLE if a rating is granted retroactively.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (25) GI BILL TRANSFER TO A SPOUSE OR CHILD MUST HAPPEN WHILE ON ACTIVE DUTY. After separation it is permanently too late.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (26) COMPARE VR&E AGAINST THE GI BILL -- VR&E has no tuition cap and pays for tools, equipment, and assistive technology.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (27) USERRA HAS NO STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS and applies to virtually all employers regardless of size. DOL VETS: 866-487-2365.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (28) IN FEDERAL HIRING, INVOKE A HIRING AUTHORITY -- VRA, 30 percent disabled, or VEOA -- not just preference points.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (29) AID AND ATTENDANCE IS THE MOST UNDERCLAIMED BENEFIT FOR ELDERLY VETERANS AND SURVIVING SPOUSES, and unreimbursed medical expenses including assisted living are DEDUCTED from income.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (30) DIC MAY BE PAYABLE EVEN WHERE DEATH WAS UNRELATED TO SERVICE if the veteran was totally disabled for the required period. FILE WITHIN 1 YEAR OF DEATH.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (31) APPLY FOR PRE-NEED BURIAL ELIGIBILITY WHILE HEALTHY.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (32) CAREGIVERS: 855-260-3274. The stipend program now covers ALL ERAS, and a broader general caregiver program exists without the stipend.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (33) A PERMANENT AND TOTAL RATING CARRIES CHAMPVA COVERAGE FOR SPOUSE AND CHILDREN. File CHAMPVA claims within 1 YEAR of service.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (34) IF ARRESTED, SAY YOU ARE A VETERAN IMMEDIATELY AND BEFORE ANY PLEA. Treatment court eligibility frequently closes after a plea.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (35) DURING INCARCERATION, THE WITHHELD BENEFIT CAN BE APPORTIONED TO THE FAMILY -- but someone must apply.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (36) WOMEN VETERANS: 855-829-6636, and ask for the WOMEN VETERANS PROGRAM MANAGER by title at your facility.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (37) FILE BENEFICIARY TRAVEL CLAIMS WITHIN 30 DAYS.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive

text: (38) ASK THE COUNTY VETERAN SERVICE OFFICER TO SCREEN YOU FOR STATE BENEFITS -- PROPERTY TAX EXEMPTIONS ALONE can be worth more annually than a rating increase.
verification_note: document-level status of the deep dive
